title: I Peter 3:18
text: For Christ himself died to atone for sins once for all--the good on behalf of the bad--that he might bring you to God; his body being put to death, but his spirit entering upon new Life.

title: I Peter 3:19
text: And it was then that he went and preached to the imprisoned spirits,

title: I Peter 3:20
text: who once were disobedient, at the time when God patiently waited, in the days of Noah, while the ark was being prepared; in which some few lives, eight in all, were saved by means of water.

title: I Peter 3:21
text: And baptism, which this foreshadowed, now saves you--not the mere cleansing of the body, but the search of a clear conscience after God--through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

title: I Peter 3:22
text: who has gone into Heaven, and is at God's right hand, where Angels and Archangels and the Powers of Heaven now yield submission to him.

title: I Peter 4:1
text: Since, then, Christ suffered in body, arm yourselves with the same resolve as he; for he who has suffered in body has ceased to sin,

title: I Peter 4:2
text: and so will live the rest of his earthly life guided, not by human passions, but by the will of God.

title: I Peter 4:3
text: Surely in the past you have spent time enough living as the Gentiles delight to live. For your path has lain among scenes of debauchery, licentiousness, drunkenness, revelry, hard-drinking, and profane idolatry.

title: I Peter 4:4
text: And, because you do not run to the same extremes of profligacy as others, they are astonished, and malign you.

title: I Peter 4:5
text: But they will have to answer for their conduct to him who is ready to judge both the living and the dead.

title: I Peter 4:6
text: For that was why the Good News was told to the dead also--that, after they have been judged in the body, as men are judged, they might live in the spirit, as God lives.

title: I Peter 4:7
text: But the end of all things is near. Therefore exercise self-restraint and be calm, that you may be able to pray.

title: I Peter 4:8
text: Above all things, let your love for one another be earnest, for 'Love throws a veil over countless sins.'

title: I Peter 4:9
text: Never grudge hospitality to one another.

title: I Peter 4:10
text: Whatever the gift that each has received, use it in the service of others, as good stewards of the varied bounty of God.

title: I Peter 4:11
text: When any one speaks, let him speak as one who is delivering the oracles of God. When any one is endeavoring to serve others, let him do so in reliance on the strength which God supplies; so that in everything God may be honour ed through Jesus Christ--to whom be ascribed all honour and might for ever and ever. Amen.

title: I Peter 4:12
text: Dear friends, do not be astonished at the fiery trials that you are passing through, to test you, as though something strange were happening to you.

title: I Peter 4:13
text: No, the more you share the sufferings of the Christ, the more may you rejoice, that, when the time comes for the manifestation of his Glory, you may rejoice and exult.

title: I Peter 4:14
text: If you are reviled for bearing the name of Christ, count yourselves blessed; because the divine Glory and the Spirit of God are resting upon you.

title: I Peter 4:15
text: I need hardly say that no one among you must suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or a criminal, or for interfering in matters which do not concern Christians.

title: I Peter 4:16
text: But, if a man suffers as a Christian, do not let him be ashamed of it; let him bring honour to God even though he bears that name.

title: I Peter 4:17
text: For the time has come for judgement to begin with the House of God; and, if it begins with us, what will be the end of those who reject God's Good News?

title: I Peter 4:18
text: If 'a good man is saved only with difficulty, what will become of the godless and the sinful?'

title: I Peter 4:19
text: Therefore, I say, let those who suffer, because God wills it so, commit their lives into the hands of a faithful Creator, and persevere in doing right.

title: I Peter 5:1
text: As for the older men among you, who bear office in the Church, I, their fellow-Officer, and a witness to the sufferings of the Christ, who shall also share in the glory that is to be revealed--

title: I Peter 5:2
text: I urge you to be true shepherds of the flock of God among you, not because you are compelled, but of your own free will; not from a base love of gain, but with a ready spirit;

title: I Peter 5:3
text: not as lords of your charges, but as examples to your flock.

title: I Peter 5:4
text: Then, when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will win the crown of glory that never fades.

title: I Peter 5:5
text: Again, you younger men should show deference to the older. And all of you should put on the badge of humility in mutual service, for 'God is opposed to the proud, but gives his help to the humble.'

title: I Peter 5:6
text: Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God, so that he may exalt you in his good time,

title: I Peter 5:7
text: laying all your anxieties upon him, for he makes you his care.

title: I Peter 5:8
text: Exercise self-control, be watchful. Your adversary, the Devil, like a roaring lion, is prowling about, eager to devour you.

title: I Peter 5:9
text: Stand firm against him, strong in your faith; knowing, as you do, that the very sufferings which you are undergoing are being endured to the full by your Brotherhood throughout the world.

title: I Peter 5:10
text: God, from whom all help comes, and who called you, by your union with Christ, into his eternal glory, will, when you have suffered for a little while, himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.

title: I Peter 5:11
text: To him be ascribed dominion for ever. Amen.

title: I Peter 5:12
text: I have been writing to you briefly by the hand of Silas, our true-hearted Brother (for so I regard him), to urge upon you, and to bear my testimony, that in what I have written is to be found the true love of God. On that take your stand.

title: I Peter 5:13
text: Your sister-Church in 'Babylon' sends you greeting, and so does Mark, who is as a son to me.

title: I Peter 5:14
text: Greet one another with the kiss of love. May God give his peace to you all in your union with Christ.

title: II Peter 1:1
text: To those to whom, through the justice of our God and Savior Jesus Christ, there has been granted faith equally privileged with our own, from Simon Peter, a servant and an Apostle of Jesus Christ.

title: II Peter 1:2
text: May blessing and peace be yours in ever-increasing measure, as you advance in the knowledge of God and of Jesus, our Lord.

title: II Peter 1:3
text: For his divine power has given us everything that is needful for a life of piety, as we advance in the knowledge of him who called us by a glorious manifestation of his goodness.

title: II Peter 1:4
text: For it was through this that he gave us what we prize as the greatest of his promises, that through them you might participate in the divine nature, now that you have fled from the corruption in the world, resulting from human passions.

title: II Peter 1:5
text: Yes, and for this very reason do your best to supplement your faith by goodness, goodness by knowledge,

title: II Peter 1:6
text: knowledge by self-control, self-control by endurance, endurance by piety,

title: II Peter 1:7
text: piety by brotherly affection, and brotherly affection by love.

title: II Peter 1:8
text: For, when these virtues are yours, in increasing measure, they prevent your being indifferent to, or destitute of, a fuller knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Peter 1:9
text: Surely the man who has not these virtues is shortsighted even to blindness, and has chosen to forget that he has been purified from his sins of the past!

title: II Peter 1:10
text: Therefore, Brothers, do your best to put God's Call and Selection of you beyond all doubt; for, if you do this, you will never fall.

title: II Peter 1:11
text: For thus you will be given a triumphant admission into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

title: II Peter 1:12
text: I shall, therefore, always be ready to remind you of all this, even though you know it and are firmly established in the Truth that you now hold.

title: II Peter 1:13
text: But I think it my duty, as long as I live in this 'tent,' to rouse you by awakening memories of the past;

title: II Peter 1:14
text: for I know that the time for this 'tent' of mine to be put away is soon coming, as our Lord Jesus Christ himself assured me.

title: II Peter 1:15
text: So I will do my best to enable you, at any time after my departure, to call these truths to mind.

title: II Peter 1:16
text: For we were not following cleverly devised stories when we told you of the Coming in power of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we had been eye-witnesses of his majesty.

title: II Peter 1:17
text: For he received honour and glory from God the Father, when from the Glory of the Divine Majesty there were borne to his ears words such as these-- 'This is my Son, my Beloved, in whom I delight.'

title: II Peter 1:18
text: These were the words that we heard, borne to our ears from Heaven, when we were with him on that Sacred Mountain.

title: II Peter 1:19
text: And still stronger is the assurance that we have in the teaching of the Prophets; to which you will do well to pay attention (as if it were a lamp shining in a gloomy place), until the Day dawns and the Morning Star rises in your hearts.

title: II Peter 1:20
text: But first be assured of this:--There is no prophetic teaching found in Scripture that can be interpreted by man's unaided reason;

title: II Peter 1:21
text: for no prophetic teaching ever came in the old days at the mere wish of man, but men, moved by the Holy Spirit, spoke direct from God.

title: II Peter 2:1
text: But there were false prophets also in the nation, just as there will be false teachers among you, men who will secretly introduce ruinous divisions, disowning even the Lord who bought them, and bringing speedy Ruin upon themselves.

title: II Peter 2:2
text: There will be many, too, who will follow their licentious courses, and cause the Way of the Truth to be maligned.

title: II Peter 2:3
text: In their covetousness they will try to make you a source of profit by their fabrications; but for a long time past their Sentence has not been standing idle, nor their Ruin slumbering.

title: II Peter 2:4
text: Remember, God did not spare angels when they sinned, but sent them down to Tartarus, and committed them to caverns of darkness, to be kept under guard for judgement.

title: II Peter 2:5
text: Nor did he spare the world of old; though he preserved Noah, the Preacher of Righteousness, and seven others, when he brought a flood upon the godless world.

title: II Peter 2:6
text: He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and reduced them to ashes, holding them up as a warning to the godless of what was in store for them;

title: II Peter 2:7
text: but he rescued righteous Lot, whose heart was vexed by the wanton licentiousness of his neighbors;

title: II Peter 2:8
text: for, seeing and hearing what he did, as he lived his righteous life among them, day after day, Lot's righteous soul was tortured by their wicked doings.

title: II Peter 2:9
text: The Lord, therefore, knows how to deliver the pious from temptation, and to keep the wicked, who are even now suffering punishment, in readiness for 'the Day of Judgement'--

title: II Peter 2:10
text: especially those who, following the promptings of their lower nature, indulge their polluting passions and despise all control. Audacious and self-willed, they feel no awe of the Mighty, maligning them,

title: II Peter 2:11
text: even where angels, though excelling them in strength and power, do not bring against them a malignant charge before the Lord.

title: II Peter 2:12
text: These men, however, like animals without reason, intended by nature to be caught and killed--these men, I say, malign those of whom they know nothing, and will assuredly perish through their own corruption,

title: II Peter 2:13
text: suffering themselves, as the penalty for the suffering that they have inflicted. They think that pleasure consists in the self-indulgence of the moment. They are a stain and a disgrace, indulging, as they do, in their wanton revelry, even while joining you at your feasts.

title: II Peter 2:14
text: They have eyes only for adulteresses, eyes never tired of sin; they entice weak souls; their minds are trained to covet; they live under a curse.

title: II Peter 2:15
text: Leaving the straight road, they have gone astray and followed in the steps of Balaam, the son of Beor, who set his heart on the reward for wrong-doing,

title: II Peter 2:16
text: but was rebuked for his offense. A dumb animal spoke with the voice of a man, and checked the prophet's madness.

title: II Peter 2:17
text: These men are like springs without water, or mists driven before a gale; and for them the blackest darkness has been reserved.

title: II Peter 2:18
text: With boastful and foolish talk, they appeal to the passions of man's lower nature, and, by their profligacy, entice those who are just escaping from the men who live such misguided lives.

title: II Peter 2:19
text: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves to corrupt habits; for a man is the slave of anything to which he gives way.

title: II Peter 2:20
text: If, after having escaped the polluting influences of the world, through knowing our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ, men are again entangled in them, and give way to them, their last state has become worse than their first.

title: II Peter 2:21
text: It would, indeed, have been better for them not to have known the Way of Righteousness, than, after knowing it, to turn away from the holy Command delivered to them.

title: II Peter 2:22
text: In their case is seen the truth of the proverb-- 'A dog returns to what he has vomited' and 'A sow after washing to her wallowing-place in the mud.'

title: II Peter 3:1
text: This, dear friends, is my second letter to you. In both of them I have tried, by appealing to your remembrance, to arouse your better feelings.

title: II Peter 3:2
text: I want you to recall what was foretold by the holy Prophets, as well as the Command of our Lord and Savior given to you through your Apostles.

title: II Peter 3:3
text: First be assured of this, that, as the age draws to an end, scoffers, led by their own passions,

title: II Peter 3:4
text: will come and ask scoffingly-- 'Where is his promised Coming? Ever since our fathers passed to their rest, everything remains just as it was when the world was first created!'

title: II Peter 3:5
text: For they wilfully shut their eyes to the fact that long ago the heavens existed; and the earth, also--formed out of water and by the action of water, by the fiat of God;

title: II Peter 3:6
text: and that by the same means the world which then existed was destroyed in a deluge of water.

title: II Peter 3:7
text: But the present heavens and earth, by the same fiat, have been reserved for fire, and are being kept for the day of the judgement and destruction of the godless.

title: II Peter 3:8
text: But you, dear friends, must never shut your eyes to the fact that, to the Lord, one day is the same as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

title: II Peter 3:9
text: The Lord is not slow to fulfil his promise, as some count slowness; but he is forbearing with you, as it is not his will that any of you should perish, but that all should be brought to repentance.

title: II Peter 3:10
text: The Day of the Lord will come like a thief; and on that day the heavens will pass away with a crash, the elements will be burnt up and dissolved, and the earth and all that is in it will be disclosed.

title: II Peter 3:11
text: Now, since all these things are in the process of dissolution, think what you yourselves ought to be--what holy and pious lives you ought to lead,

title: II Peter 3:12
text: while you await and hasten the coming of the Day of God. At its coming the heavens will be dissolved in fire, and the elements melted by heat,

title: II Peter 3:13
text: but we look for 'new heavens and a new earth,' where righteousness shall have its home, in fulfilment of the promise of God.

title: II Peter 3:14
text: Therefore, dear friends, in expectation of these things, make every effort to be found by him spotless, blameless, and at peace.

title: II Peter 3:15
text: Regard our Lord's forbearance as your one hope of Salvation. This is what our dear Brother Paul wrote to you, with the wisdom that God gave him.

title: II Peter 3:16
text: It is the same in all his letters, when he speaks in them about these subjects. There are some things in them difficult to understand, which untaught and weak people distort, just as they do all other writings, to their own Ruin.

title: II Peter 3:17
text: Do you, therefore, dear friends, now that you know this beforehand, be on your guard against being led away by the errors of reckless people, and so lapsing from your present steadfastness;

title: II Peter 3:18
text: and advance in the love and knowledge of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. All glory be to him now and for ever.

title: I John 1:1
text: It is of what has been in existence from the Beginning, of what we have heard, of what we have seen with our eyes, of what we watched reverently and touched with our hands--it is about the Word who is the Life that we are now writing.

title: I John 1:2
text: That Life was made visible, and we have seen it, and now bear our testimony to it, and tell you of that Immortal Life, which was with the Father and was made visible to us.

title: I John 1:3
text: It is of what we have seen and heard that we now tell you, so that you may have communion with us. And our communion is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

title: I John 1:4
text: And we are writing all this to you that our joy may be complete.

title: I John 1:5
text: These, then, are the Tidings that we have heard from him and now tell you-- 'God is Light, and Darkness has no place at all in him.'

title: I John 1:6
text: If we say that we have communion with him, and yet continue to live in the Darkness, we lie, and are not living the Truth.

title: I John 1:7
text: But, if our lives are lived in the Light, as God himself is in the Light, we have communion with one another, and the Blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

title: I John 1:8
text: If we say that there is no sin in us, we are deceiving ourselves, and the Truth has no place in us.

title: I John 1:9
text: If we confess our sins, God may be trusted, in his righteousness, to forgive us our sins and purify us from all wickedness.

title: I John 1:10
text: If we say that we have not sinned, we are making God a liar, and his Message has no place in us.

title: I John 2:1
text: My children, I am writing to you to keep you from sinning; but if any one should sin, we have one who can plead for us with the Father--Jesus Christ, the Righteous--

title: I John 2:2
text: and he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but for those of the whole world besides.

title: I John 2:3
text: And by this we know that we have learned to know him--by our laying his commands to heart.

title: I John 2:4
text: The man who says 'I know Jesus,' but does not lay his commands to heart, is a liar, and the Truth has no place in him;

title: I John 2:5
text: but, whenever a man lays his Message to heart, in that man the love of God has indeed reached its perfection. By this we know that we are in union with God--

title: I John 2:6
text: He who professes to maintain union with God is himself bound to live as Christ lived.

title: I John 2:7
text: Dear friends, it is no new command that I am writing to you, but an old command, which you have had from the first. That old command is the Message to which you listened.

title: I John 2:8
text: Yet, again, it is a new Command that I am writing to you-- manifest in Christ's life and in your own--for the Darkness is passing away and the true Light is already shining.

title: I John 2:9
text: He who says that he is in the Light, and yet hates his Brother, is in the Darkness even now.

title: I John 2:10
text: He who loves his Brother is always in the Light, and there is nothing within him to cause him to stumble;

title: I John 2:11
text: while he who hates his Brother is in the Darkness, and is living in the Darkness, and does not know where he is going, because the Darkness prevents his seeing.

title: I John 2:12
text: I am writing, Children, to you, because your sins have been forgiven you for Christ's sake.

title: I John 2:13
text: I am writing, Fathers, to you, because you have learned to know him who has been from the Beginning. I am writing, Young Men, to you, because you have conquered the Evil One. I write, Children, to you, because you have learned to know the Father.

title: I John 2:14
text: I write, Fathers, to you, because you have learned to know him who has been from the Beginning. I write, Young Men, to you, because you are strong, and God's Message is always in your hearts, and you have conquered the Evil One.

title: I John 2:15
text: Do not love the world or what the world can offer. When any one loves the world, there is no love for the Father in him;

title: I John 2:16
text: for all that the world can offer--the gratification of the earthly nature, the gratification of the eye, the pretentious life--belongs, not to the Father, but to the world.

title: I John 2:17
text: And the world, and all that it gratifies, is passing away, but he who does God's will remains for ever.

title: I John 2:18
text: My Children, these are the last days. You were told that an Anti-Christ was coming; and many Anti-Christ's have already arisen. By that we know that these are the last days.

title: I John 2:19
text: From us, it is true, they went out, but they had never belonged to us; for, if they had belonged to us, they would have remained among us. They left us that it might be made clear that they do not, any of them, belong to us.

title: I John 2:20
text: You, however, have received consecration from the Holy One.

title: I John 2:21
text: You all know--But I am not writing to you because you do not know the Truth, but because you do know it, and because nothing false can come from the Truth.

title: I John 2:22
text: Who is a liar, if not the man who rejects the truth that Jesus is the Christ? He is the Anti-Christ--The man who rejects the Father and the Son.

title: I John 2:23
text: No one who rejects the Son has found the Father; he who acknowledges the Son has found the Father also.

title: I John 2:24
text: As for you, let what you were told at the first be always in your thoughts. If, then, what you were told at the first is always in your thoughts, you yourselves will maintain your union both with the Son and with the Father.

title: I John 2:25
text: And this is what he himself promised us--The Immortal Life!

title: I John 2:26
text: In writing thus to you, I have in mind those who are trying to mislead you.

title: I John 2:27
text: But you--you still retain in your hears that consecration which you received from the Christ, and are not in need of any one to teach you; but, since his consecration of you teaches you about everything, and since it is a real consecration, and no lie, then, as it has taught you, maintain your union with him.

title: I John 2:28
text: Yes, my Children, maintain your union with Christ, so that, whenever he appears, our confidence may not fail us, and we may not be ashamed to meet him at his coming.

title: I John 2:29
text: Knowing him to be righteous, you realize that every one who lives righteously has received the new Life from him.

title: I John 3:1
text: Think what love the Father has shown us in allowing us to be called 'Children of God'; as indeed we are. The reason why the world does not know us is that it has not learned to know him.

title: I John 3:2
text: Dear friends, we are God's Children now; what we shall be has not yet been revealed. What we do know is that, when it is revealed, we shall be like Christ; because we shall see him as he is.

title: I John 3:3
text: And every one who has this hope with regard to Christ tries to make himself pure--as Christ is pure.

title: I John 3:4
text: Every one who lives sinfully is living in violation of Law. Sin is violation of Law.

title: I John 3:5
text: And you know that Christ appeared to take away our sins; and in him Sin has no place.

title: I John 3:6
text: No one who maintains union with him lives in sin; no one who lives in sin has ever really seen him or learned to know him.

title: I John 3:7
text: My Children, do not let any one mislead you. He who lives righteously is righteous--as Christ is righteous.

title: I John 3:8
text: He who lives sinfully belongs to the Devil, for the Devil has sinned from the first. It was for this that the Son of God appeared, that he might undo the Devil's work.

title: I John 3:9
text: No one who has received the new Life from God lives sinfully, because the very nature of God dwells within him; and he cannot live in sin, because he has received the new Life from God.

title: I John 3:10
text: By this the Children of God are distinguished from the Children of the Devil--No one who lives unrighteously comes from God, and especially the man who does not love his Brother.

title: I John 3:11
text: For these are the Tidings that we heard from the first--that we are to love one another.

title: I John 3:12
text: We must not be like Cain, who belonged to the Evil One and killed his brother. And why did he kill him? It was because his life was bad while his brother's was good.

title: I John 3:13
text: Do not wonder, Brothers, if the world hates you.

title: I John 3:14
text: We know that we have passed out of Death into Life, because we love our Brothers. The man who does not love remains in a state of Death.

title: I John 3:15
text: Every one who hates his Brother is a murderer; and you know that no murderer has Immortal Life within him.

title: I John 3:16
text: We have learned to know what love is from this--that Christ laid down his life on our behalf. Therefore we also ought to lay down our lives on behalf of our Brothers.

title: I John 3:17
text: But, if any one has worldly possessions, and yet looks on while his Brother is in want, and steels his heart against him, how can it be said that the love of God is within him?

title: I John 3:18
text: My children, do not let our love be mere words, or end in talk; let it be true and show itself    in acts.

title: I John 3:19
text: By that we shall know that we are on the side of the Truth; and we shall satisfy ourselves in God's sight,

title: I John 3:20
text: that if our conscience condemns us, yet God is greater than our conscience and knows everything.

title: I John 3:21
text: Dear friends, if our conscience does not condemn us, then we approach God with confidence,

title: I John 3:22
text: and we receive from him whatever we ask, because we are laying his commands to heart, and are doing what is pleasing in his sight.

title: I John 3:23
text: His Command is this--that we should put our trust in the Name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, in accordance with the Command that he gave us.

title: I John 3:24
text: And he who lays his commands to heart maintains union with Christ, and Christ with him. And by this we know that Christ maintains union with us--by our possession of the Spirit which he gave us.

title: I John 4:1
text: Dear friends, do not trust every inspiration, but test each inspiration, to see whether it proceeds from God; because many false Prophets have gone out into the world.

title: I John 4:2
text: This is the way by which to know the inspiration of God--All inspiration that acknowledges Jesus Christ as come in our human nature is from God;

title: I John 4:3
text: while all inspiration that does not acknowledge Jesus is not inspiration from God. It is the inspiration of the Anti-Christ; you have heard that it was to come, and it is now already in the world.

title: I John 4:4
text: You, my Children, come from God, and you have successfully resisted such men as these, because he who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.

title: I John 4:5
text: Those men belong to the world; and therefore they speak as the world speaks, and the world listens to them.

title: I John 4:6
text: We come from God. He who knows God listens to us; the man who does not come from God does not listen to us. By that we may know the true inspiration from the false.

title: I John 4:7
text: Dear friends, let us love one another, because Love comes from God; and every one who loves has received the new Life from God and knows God.

title: I John 4:8
text: He who does not love has not learned to know God; for God is Love.

title: I John 4:9
text: The love of God was revealed to us by his sending his only Son into the world, that we might find Life through him.

title: I John 4:10
text: His love is seen in this--not in our having loved God, but in his loving us and sending his Son to be an atoning sacrifice for our sins.

title: I John 4:11
text: Dear friends, since God loved us thus, we, surely, ought to love one another.

title: I John 4:12
text: No human eyes have ever seen God, yet, if we love one another, God remains in union with us, and his love attains its perfection in us.

title: I John 4:13
text: We know that we remain in union with him, and he with us, by this--by his having given us some measure of his Spirit.

title: I John 4:14
text: Moreover, our eyes have seen--and we are testifying to the fact--that the Father has sent the Son to be the Savior of the world.

title: I John 4:15
text: Whoever acknowledges that Jesus Christ is the Son of God--God remains in union with that man, and he with God.

title: I John 4:16
text: And, moreover, we have learned to know, and have accepted as a fact, the love which God has for us. God is Love; and he who lives in love lives in God, and God in him.

title: I John 4:17
text: It is through this that love has attained its perfection in us, so that we may have confidence on the Day of Judgement, because what Christ is that we also are in this world.

title: I John 4:18
text: There is no fear in love. No! Love, when perfect, drives out fear, for fear implies punishment, and the man who feels fear has not attained to perfect love.

title: I John 4:19
text: We love, because God first loved us.

title: I John 4:20
text: If a man says 'I love God,' and yet hates his Brother, he is a liar; for the man who does not love his Brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.

title: I John 4:21
text: Indeed, we have this Command from God-- 'He who loves God must also love his Brother.'

title: I John 5:1
text: Every one who believes that Jesus is the Christ has received the new Life from God; and every one who loves him who gave that Life loves him who has received it.

title: I John 5:2
text: By this we know that we love God's Children--when we love God and carry out his commands.

title: I John 5:3
text: For to love God is to lay his commands to heart; and his commands are not burdensome,

title: I John 5:4
text: because all that has received the new Life from God conquers the world. And this is the power that has conquered the world--our faith!

title: I John 5:5
text: Who is he that conquers the world but the man who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

title: I John 5:6
text: He it is whose Coming was attested by means of Water and Blood--Jesus Christ himself; not by Water only, but by Water and by Blood. And there is the Spirit also to bear testimony, and the Spirit is Truth itself.

title: I John 5:7
text: It is a three-fold testimony--

title: I John 5:8
text: that of the Spirit, the Water, and the Blood--and these three are at one.

title: I John 5:9
text: We accept the testimony of men, but God's testimony is still stronger; and there is the testimony of God--the fact that he has already borne testimony about his Son.

title: I John 5:10
text: He who believes in the Son of God has that testimony within him. He who does not believe God has made God a liar, by refusing to believe in that testimony which he has borne about his Son.

title: I John 5:11
text: And that testimony is that God gave us Immortal Life, and that this Life is in his Son.

title: I John 5:12
text: He who finds the Son finds Life; he who does not find the Son of God does not find Life.

title: I John 5:13
text: I write this to you, that you may realize that you have found Immortal Life--you who believe in the Name of the Son of God.

title: I John 5:14
text: And this is the confidence with which we approach him, that whenever we ask anything that is in accordance with his will, he listens to us.

title: I John 5:15
text: And if we realize that he listens to us--whatever we ask--we realize that we have what we have asked from him.

title: I John 5:16
text: If any one sees his Brother committing some sin that is not a deadly sin, he will ask, and so be the means of giving Life to him--to any whose sin is not deadly. There is such a thing as deadly sin; about that I do not say that a man should pray.

title: I John 5:17
text: Every wrong action is sin, and there is sin that is not deadly.

title: I John 5:18
text: We know that no one who has received the new Life from God lives in sin. No, he who has received the new Life from God keeps the thought of God in his heart, and then the Evil One does not touch him.

title: I John 5:19
text: We realize that we come from God, while all the world is under the influence of the Evil One.

title: I John 5:20
text: We realize, too, that the Son of God has come among us, and has given us the discernment to know the True God; and we are in union with the True God by our union with his Son, Jesus Christ. He is the True God and he is Immortal Life.

title: I John 5:21
text: My Children, guard yourselves against false ideas of God.

title: II John 1:1
text: To an eminent Christian Lady, and to her Children, from the Officer of the Church. I sincerely love you all, and not I only, but also all those who have learned to know the Truth.

title: II John 1:2
text: We love you for the sake of that Truth which is always in our hearts; yes, and it will be ours for ever.

title: II John 1:3
text: Blessing, mercy, and peace will be ours--the gift of God, the Father, and of Jesus Christ, the Father's Son--in a life of truth and love.

title: II John 1:4
text: It was a great joy to me to find the lives of some of your children guided by the Truth, in obedience to the command that we received from the Father.

title: II John 1:5
text: And now, I pray you, Lady--not as though I were writing a new command for you; no, it is the command which we had from the first--Let us love one another.

title: II John 1:6
text: And this is love--to live in obedience to the Father's commands. This is the Command as you learned from the first, to live in a spirit of love.

title: II John 1:7
text: I say this because many impostors have left us to go into the world--men who do not acknowledge Jesus as Christ come in our human nature. It is that which marks a man as an impostor and an anti-Christ.

title: II John 1:8
text: Take care that you do not lose the fruit of all our work; rather, reap the benefit of it in full.

title: II John 1:9
text: Every one who goes beyond the limits of the Teaching of the Christ has failed to find God; the man who keeps to that Teaching--he has found both the Father and the Son.

title: II John 1:10
text: If any one comes to you and does not bring this Teaching, do not receive him into your house or welcome him;

title: II John 1:11
text: for the man who welcomes him is sharing with him in his wicked work.

title: II John 1:12
text: Though I have a great deal to say to you, I would rather not trust it to paper and ink, but I am hoping to come and see you, and to speak with you face to face, so that your joy may be complete.

title: II John 1:13
text: The children of your eminent sister send you their greetings.

title: III John 1:1
text: To his dear friend Gaius, whom he sincerely loves, From the Officer of the Church.

title: III John 1:2
text: Dear friend, I pray that all may be well with you and that you may have good health--I know that all is well with your soul.

title: III John 1:3
text: For it was a great joy to me, when some Brothers came and testified to your fidelity to the Truth--I know that your own life is guided by the Truth.

title: III John 1:4
text: Nothing gives me greater pleasure than to hear from time to time that the lives of my Children are guided by the Truth.

title: III John 1:5
text: Dear friend, whatever you do for our Brothers is done in a Christian spirit--even when they are strangers to you.

title: III John 1:6
text: They themselves have testified before the Church to your love; and you will do well to help them on their way in a manner worthy of the service of God.

title: III John 1:7
text: For it was on behalf of the Name that they left their homes, and refused to take anything from the Gentiles.

title: III John 1:8
text: We, therefore, ought to give such people a hearty welcome, and so take our share in their work for the Truth.

title: III John 1:9
text: I wrote a few lines to the Church; but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, declines to recognize us.

title: III John 1:10
text: Therefore, when I come, I shall not forget his conduct in ridiculing us with his wicked tongue. Not content with that, he not only declines to recognize our Brothers himself, but actually prevents those who would, and expels them from the Church.

title: III John 1:11
text: Dear friend, take what is good for your example , not what is bad. The man who does what is good is from God; the man who does what is bad has never seen God.

title: III John 1:12
text: Every one has always had a good word for Demetrius, and the Truth itself speaks for him. Yes, and we also add our good word, and you know that what we say about him is true.

title: III John 1:13
text: I have a great deal to say to you, but I do not care to trust it to pen and ink in a letter.

title: III John 1:14
text: I hope, however, it will not be long before I see you, and then we will speak face to face. Peace be with you. Our friends here send you their greetings. Greet each one of our friends.

title: Jude 1:1
text: To those who, having received the Call, have been loved by God the Father and protected by Jesus Christ, From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and the brother of James.

title: Jude 1:2
text: May mercy, peace, and love be yours in ever-increasing measure.

title: Jude 1:3
text: Dear friends, while I was making every effort to write to you about our common Salvation, I felt that I must write to you at once to urge you to fight in defense of the Faith that has once for all been entrusted to the keeping of Christ's People.

title: Jude 1:4
text: For there have crept in among you certain godless people, whose sentence has long since been pronounced, and who make the mercy of God an excuse for profligacy, and disown our only lord and master, Jesus Christ.

title: Jude 1:5
text: Now I want to remind you--but you already know it all--that, though the Lord delivered the People from Egypt, yet he afterwards destroyed those who refused to believe in him;

title: Jude 1:6
text: and that even those angels, who did not keep to their appointed spheres, but left their proper homes, have been kept by him for the judgement of the Great Day in everlasting chains and black darkness.

title: Jude 1:7
text: Like Sodom and Gomorrah and the towns near them, which gave themselves up to fornication, and fell into unnatural vice, these angels now stand out as a warning, undergoing, as they are, the punishment of aeonian fire.

title: Jude 1:8
text: Yet in the very same way these men, too, cherishing vain dreams, pollute our human nature, reject control, and malign the Mighty.

title: Jude 1:9
text: Yet even Michael, the Archangel, when, in his dispute with the Devil, he was arguing about the body of Moses, did not venture to charge him with maligning, but said merely 'The Lord rebuke you!'

title: Jude 1:10
text: But these men malign whatever they do not understand; while they use such things as they know by instinct (like the animals that have no reason) for their own corruption.

title: Jude 1:11
text: Alas for them! They walk in the steps of Cain; led astray by Balaam's love of gain, they plunge into sin, and meet their ruin through rebellion like that of Korah.

title: Jude 1:12
text: These are the men who are blots upon your 'Love-feasts,' when they feast together and provide without scruple for themselves alone. They are clouds without rain, driven before the winds; they are leafless trees without a vestige of fruit, dead through and through, torn up by the roots;

title: Jude 1:13
text: They are wild sea waves, foaming with their own shame; they are 'wandering stars,' for which the blackest darkness has been reserved for ever.

title: Jude 1:14
text: To these men, as to others, Enoch, the seventh in descent from Adam, declared-- 'See! the Lord has come with his hosts of holy ones around him,

title: Jude 1:15
text: to execute judgement upon all men, and to convict all godless people of all their godless acts, which in their ungodliness they have committed, and of all the harsh words which they have spoken against him, godless sinners that they are!'

title: Jude 1:16
text: These men are always murmuring, and complaining of their lot; they follow where their passions lead them; they have arrogant words upon their lips; and they flatter men for the sake of what they can get from them.

title: Jude 1:17
text: But do you, dear friends, recall what was foretold by the Apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

title: Jude 1:18
text: how they used to say to you-- 'As time draws to an end, there will be scoffers, who will be led by their godless passions.'

title: Jude 1:19
text: These are the people--animal and unspiritual--who cause divisions.

title: Jude 1:20
text: But do you, dear friends, build up your characters on the foundation of your most holy Faith, pray under the guidance of the Holy Spirit,

title: Jude 1:21
text: and keep within the love of God, while waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ, to bring you to Immortal Life.

title: Jude 1:22
text: To some show pity, because they are in doubt. 'Drag them out of the fire,' and save them.

title: Jude 1:23
text: To others show pity, but with caution, hating the very clothing polluted by their touch.

title: Jude 1:24
text: To him who is able to guard you from falling, and to bring you into his glorious presence, blameless and rejoicing-

title: Jude 1:25
text: to the one God, our Saviour, be ascribed, through Jesus Christ, our Lord, glory, majesty, power, and dominion, as it was before time began, is now, and shall be for all time to come. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:1
text: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to him to make known to his servants, concerning what must shortly take place, and which he sent and revealed by his angel to his servant John,

title: Revelation of John 1:2
text: who testified to the Message of God and to the testimony to Jesus Christ, omitting nothing of what he had seen.

title: Revelation of John 1:3
text: Blessed is he who reads, and blessed are they who listen to, the words of this prophecy, and lay to heart what is here written; for The Time is near.

title: Revelation of John 1:4
text: From John, to the seven Churches which are in Roman Asia. Blessing and peace be yours from him who is, and who was, and who shall be, and from the seven Spirits that are before his throne,

title: Revelation of John 1:5
text: and from Jesus Christ, ' the faithful Witness, the First-born from the dead, and the Ruler of all the Kings of the earth.' To him who loves us and freed us from our sins by his own blood--

title: Revelation of John 1:6
text: and he made us ' a Kingdom of Priests in the service of God,' his Father ! --to Him be ascribed glory and dominion for ever. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:7
text: ' He is coming among the clouds!' Every eye shall see him, even those who pierced him; 'and all the nations of the earth shall wail for fear of him.' So shall it be. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:8
text: 'I am the Alpha and the Omega,' says the Lord, the God who is, and who was, and who shall be, the Almighty.

title: Revelation of John 1:9
text: I, John, who am your Brother, and who share with you in the suffering and kingship and endurance of Jesus, found myself on the island called Patmos, for the sake of the Message of God and the testimony to Jesus.

title: Revelation of John 1:10
text: I fell into a trance on the Lord's Day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like the blast of a trumpet.

title: Revelation of John 1:11
text: It said--' Write what you see in a book and send it to the seven Churches, to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamus, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicaea.'

title: Revelation of John 1:12
text: I turned to see what voice it was that spoke to me; and when I turned, I saw seven golden lamps,

title: Revelation of John 1:13
text: and in the midst of the lamps one 'like a man, in a robe reaching to his feet,' and with a golden girdle across his breast.

title: Revelation of John 1:14
text: 'The hair of his head was as white as wool, as white as snow; his eyes were like flaming fire;

title: Revelation of John 1:15
text: and his feet were like brass' as when molten in a furnace; 'his voice was like the sound of many streams,'

title: Revelation of John 1:16
text: in his right hand he held seven stars, from his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword, and his face was like 'the sun in the fulness of its power.'

title: Revelation of John 1:17
text: And, when I saw him, I fell at his feet like one dead. He laid his hand on me and said-- 'Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,

title: Revelation of John 1:18
text: the Everliving. I died, and I am alive for ever and ever. And I hold the keys of the Grave and of the Place of the Dead.

title: Revelation of John 1:19
text: Therefore write of what you have seen and of what is happening now and of what is about to take place--

title: Revelation of John 1:20
text: the mystic meaning of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamps. The seven stars are the Angels of the seven Churches, and the seven lamps are the seven Churches.

title: Revelation of John 2:1
text: To the Angel of the Church in Ephesus write:-- "These are the words of him who holds the seven stars in his right hand, and walks among the seven golden lamps:--

title: Revelation of John 2:2
text: I know your life, your toil and endurance, and I know that you cannot tolerate evil-doers. I know, too, how you tested those who declare that they are Apostles, though they are not, and how you proved them false.

title: Revelation of John 2:3
text: You possess endurance, and have borne much for my Name, and have never grown weary.

title: Revelation of John 2:4
text: But this I have against you--You have abandoned your first love.

title: Revelation of John 2:5
text: Therefore remember from what you have fallen, and repent, and live the life that you lived before; or else, I will come and remove your Lamp from its place, unless you repent.

title: Revelation of John 2:6
text: But this is in your favor--You hate the life lived by the Nikolaitans, and I also hate it.

title: Revelation of John 2:7
text: Let him who has ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the Churches. To him who conquers-- to him I will give the right 'to eat the fruit of the Tree of life, which stands in the Paradise of God.' "

title: Revelation of John 2:8
text: To the Angel of the Church in Smyrna write:-- "These are the words of him who is the First and the Last, who died, but is restored to life:--

title: Revelation of John 2:9
text: I know your persecution and your poverty--yet you are rich! I know, too, the slander that come from those who declare that they are Jews, though they are not, but are a Congregation of Satan.

title: Revelation of John 2:10
text: Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. The Devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tempted, and may undergo persecution for ten days. Be faithful even to death, and I will give you the Crown of Life.

title: Revelation of John 2:11
text: Let him who has ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the Churches. He who conquers shall suffer no hurt from the Second Death."

title: Revelation of John 2:12
text: To the Angel of the Church in Pergamus write:-- "These are the words of him who holds the sharp two-edged sword:--

title: Revelation of John 2:13
text: I know where you dwell, where the Throne of Satan stands. And yet you hold to my Name, and you did not disown my Faith even in the days of Antipas, my faithful witness, who was put to death among you where Satan dwells.

title: Revelation of John 2:14
text: Yet I have a few things against you--You have among you those who hold to the Teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put temptations in the way of the Israelites, so that they should eat idol-offerings and commit licentious acts.

title: Revelation of John 2:15
text: Again you have among you those who hold in the same way to the Teaching of the Nikolaitans.

title: Revelation of John 2:16
text: Therefore repent, or else, I will come quickly and contend with such men with words that will cut like a sword.

title: Revelation of John 2:17
text: Let him who has ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the Churches. To him who conquers-- to him I will give a share of the mystic manna, and I will give him a white stone; and on the stone shall be inscribed a new name, which no one knows except him who receives it."

title: Revelation of John 2:18
text: To the Angel of the Church in Thyatira write:-- "These are the words of the Son of God, 'whose eyes are like flaming fire, and whose feet are like brass':--

title: Revelation of John 2:19
text: I know your life, your love, faith, service, and endurance; and I know that your life of late has been better than it was at first.

title: Revelation of John 2:20
text: Yet I have this against you--You tolerate the woman Jezebel, who declares that she is a Prophetess, and misleads my servants by her teaching, till they commit licentious acts and eat idol-offerings.

title: Revelation of John 2:21
text: I gave her time to repent, but she is determined not to turn from her licentiousness.

title: Revelation of John 2:22
text: Therefore I am laying her upon a bed of sickness, and bringing great suffering upon those who are unfaithful with her, unless they repent and turn from a life like hers.

title: Revelation of John 2:23
text: I will also put her children to death; and all the Churches shall learn that I am he who 'looks into the hearts and souls of men'; and I will give to each one of you what his life deserves.

title: Revelation of John 2:24
text: But I say to the rest of you at Thyatira--all who do not accept such teaching, whose who did not learn 'the secrets of Satan,' as men call them--I am not laying on you any further burden;

title: Revelation of John 2:25
text: only hold fast to what you have received, until I come.

title: Revelation of John 2:26
text: To him who conquers and is careful to live my life to the end--to him I will give authority over the nations,

title: Revelation of John 2:27
text: and 'he shall rule them with an iron rod, as when earthen vessels are broken in pieces' (as I myself have received from my Father)

title: Revelation of John 2:28
text: and I will give him the Morning Star.

title: Revelation of John 2:29
text: Let him who has ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the Churches."

title: Revelation of John 3:1
text: To the Angel of the Church in Sardis write:-- "These are the words of him who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars;--I know your life, and that men say of you that you are living, though you are dead.

title: Revelation of John 3:2
text: Be on the watch, and strengthen what still survives, though once it was all but dead; for I have not found your life perfect in the eyes of my God.

title: Revelation of John 3:3
text: Therefore remember what you have received and heard, and lay it to heart and repent. Unless you are on the watch, I shall come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I am coming to you.

title: Revelation of John 3:4
text: Yet there are some few among you at Sardis who did not soil their robes; they shall walk with me, robed in white, for they are worthy.

title: Revelation of John 3:5
text: He who conquers shall be clothed in these white robes, and I will not 'strike his name out of the Book of Life'; but I will own him before my Father, and before his angels.

title: Revelation of John 3:6
text: Let him who has ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the Churches."

title: Revelation of John 3:7
text: To the Angel of the Church in Philadelphia write:-- "These are the words of him who is holy and true, who holds 'the Key of David, who opens and no one shall shut, and shuts and no one opens':--

title: Revelation of John 3:8
text: I know your life (see, I have set a door open before you which no one is able to shut), I know that, though you have but little strength, you kept my teaching in mind, and did not disown my Name.

title: Revelation of John 3:9
text: Listen, I give some of the Congregation of Satan, the men who declare that they are Jews, though they are not, but are lying----I will make them 'come and bow down at your feet,' and they shall learn that I loved you.

title: Revelation of John 3:10
text: Because you kept in mind the story of my endurance, I will keep you in the hour of trial that is about to come upon the whole world, the hour that will test all who are living upon earth.

title: Revelation of John 3:11
text: I will come quickly. Hold to what you have received, that no one may take your crown.

title: Revelation of John 3:12
text: He who conquers--I will make him a pillar in the Temple of my God; and never more shall he leave it; and I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the City of my God, the New Jerusalem, which is coming down out of Heaven from my God, and I will write on him my new name.

title: Revelation of John 3:13
text: Let him who has ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the Churches."

title: Revelation of John 3:14
text: To the Angel of the Church in Laodicaea write:-- "These are the words of the Unchanging One, 'the Witness faithful and true, the Beginning of the Creation of God':--

title: Revelation of John 3:15
text: I know your life; I know that you are neither cold nor hot. Would that you were either cold or hot!

title: Revelation of John 3:16
text: But now, because you are lukewarm, neither hot not cold, I am about to spit you out of my mouth.

title: Revelation of John 3:17
text: You say 'I am rich and have grown rich, and I want for nothing,' and you do not know that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, naked!

title: Revelation of John 3:18
text: Therefore I counsel you to buy from me gold which has been refined by fire, that you may grow rich; and white robes, that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness be hidden; and ointment to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

title: Revelation of John 3:19
text: 'All whom I love I rebuke and discipline.' Therefore be in earnest and repent.

title: Revelation of John 3:20
text: I am standing at the door and knocking! If any one hears my voice and opens the door, I will go in, and will feast with him, and he shall feast with me.

title: Revelation of John 3:21
text: To him who conquers--to him I will give the right to sit beside me on my throne, as I, when I conquered, took my seat beside my Father on his throne.

title: Revelation of John 3:22
text: Let him who has ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the Churches."

title: Revelation of John 4:1
text: After this, in my vision, I saw an open door in the heavens, and the first voice that I heard was like the blast of a trumpet speaking to me. It said-- 'Come up here and I will show you what must take place.'

title: Revelation of John 4:2
text: Immediately after this I fell into a trance. There stood a throne in Heaven, and on the throne was One seated.

title: Revelation of John 4:3
text: He who was seated on it was in appearance like a jasper and a sardius; and 'round the throne there was a rainbow' of the color of an emerald.

title: Revelation of John 4:4
text: And round the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these I saw twenty-four Councillors sitting clothed in white robes; and on their heads they had crowns of gold.

title: Revelation of John 4:5
text: Out from the throne 'come flashes of lightning, cries, and peals of thunder'! There are seven torches burning in front of the throne, which are the seven spirits of God;

title: Revelation of John 4:6
text: and in front of the throne is what seemed to be a sea of glass, 'resembling crystal, while within the space before the throne and round the throne are four Creatures full of eyes' in front and behind.

title: Revelation of John 4:7
text: The first Creature is like a lion, the second Creature like a calf, the third Creature has a face like a man's, and the fourth Creature is like an eagle on the wing.

title: Revelation of John 4:8
text: These four Creatures have each of them six wings, and all round, and within, they are full of eyes; and day and night they never cease to say-- 'Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, our God, the Almighty, who was, and who is, and who shall be.'

title: Revelation of John 4:9
text: And, whenever these Creatures give praise and honour and thanks to him who is 'seated on the throne, to him who lives for ever and ever,'

title: Revelation of John 4:10
text: the twenty-four Councillors prostrate themselves before him who is seated on the throne, and worship him who lives for ever and ever, and throw down their crowns before the throne, saying--

title: Revelation of John 4:11
text: 'Worthy art thou, our Lord and God, to receive all praise, and honour, and power, for thou didst create all things, and at thy bidding they came into being and were created.'

title: Revelation of John 5:1
text: Then I saw at the right hand of him who was 'seated on the throne a book, with writing inside and out, and sealed' with seven seals;

title: Revelation of John 5:2
text: and I saw a mighty angel who was proclaiming in a loud voice-- 'Who is worthy to open the book and break its seals?'

title: Revelation of John 5:3
text: But no one either in Heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the book or look within it.

title: Revelation of John 5:4
text: At this I wept long, because no one could be found who was worthy to open the book or look within it.

title: Revelation of John 5:5
text: But one of the Councillors said to me--'Do not weep. The Lion conquered--the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Scion of David--and can therefore open the book with its seven seals.'

title: Revelation of John 5:6
text: Then, within the space between the throne and the four Creatures, and in the midst of the Councillors, I saw, standing, a Lamb, which seemed to have been sacrificed. It had seven horns and seven eyes. (These eyes are the seven Spirits of God, and they are sent into all the world.)

title: Revelation of John 5:7
text: The Lamb came forward; and he has taken the book from the right hand of him who was seated on the throne.

title: Revelation of John 5:8
text: And, when he had taken the book, the four Creatures and the twenty-four Councillors prostrated themselves before the Lamb, each of them holding a harp and golden bowls full of incense. (These are the prayers of Christ's People.)

title: Revelation of John 5:9
text: And they are singing a new song--'Thou art worthy to take the book and break its seals, for thou wast sacrificed, and with thy blood thou didst buy for God men of every tribe, and language, and people, and nation,

title: Revelation of John 5:10
text: and didst make them a Kingdom of Priests in the service of our God, and they are reigning upon the earth.'

title: Revelation of John 5:11
text: Then, in my vision, I heard the voices of many angels round the throne, and of the Creatures, and of the Councillors. In number they were 'ten thousand times ten thousand and thousands of thousands,'

title: Revelation of John 5:12
text: and they cried in a loud voice--'Worthy is the Lamb that was sacrificed to receive all power, and wealth, and wisdom, and might, and honour, and praise, and blessing.'

title: Revelation of John 5:13
text: And I heard every created thing in the air, and on the earth, and under the earth, and on the sea, and all that is in them crying--'To him who is seated on the throne and to the Lamb be ascribed all blessing, and honour, and praise, and dominion for ever and ever.'

title: Revelation of John 5:14
text: And the four Creatures said 'Amen,' and the Councillors prostrated themselves and worshiped.

title: Revelation of John 6:1
text: Then I saw the Lamb break one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four Creatures crying with a voice like thunder--'Come.'

title: Revelation of John 6:2
text: And in my vision I saw 'a white horse.' Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he went out conquering and to conquer.

title: Revelation of John 6:3
text: When the Lamb broke the second seal, I heard the second Creature crying--'Come.'

title: Revelation of John 6:4
text: Then there went out another horse, 'a red horse,' and to its rider was given the power to deprive the earth of peace, so that men should kill one another; and he was given a great sword.

title: Revelation of John 6:5
text: When the Lamb broke the third seal, I heard the third Creature crying--'Come.' And in my vision I saw 'a black horse.' Its rider held scales in his hand.

title: Revelation of John 6:6
text: And I heard what seemed to be a voice, coming from among the four Creatures, crying--'A quart of wheat for a florin, and three quarts of barley for a florin! But do not harm the oil and the wine.'

title: Revelation of John 6:7
text: When the Lamb broke the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth Creature crying-- 'Come.'

title: Revelation of John 6:8
text: And in my vision I saw a grey horse. His rider's name was Death, and the Lord of the Place of Death rode behind him; and power was given them over the fourth part of the earth, so that they might 'destroy with sword and famine and death, and by means of the wild beasts of the earth.'

title: Revelation of John 6:9
text: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the sake of God's Message and for the testimony which they had borne.

title: Revelation of John 6:10
text: They cried in a loud voice--'How long, O Sovereign Lord, holy and true, before thou wilt give judgement and avenge our blood upon all who are living upon the earth?'

title: Revelation of John 6:11
text: Then to each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to rest yet a little longer, till the number of their fellow-servants and of their Brothers who were about to be put to death, as they had been, should be complete.

title: Revelation of John 6:12
text: And I saw the Lamb break the sixth seal, and then there was a great earthquake. The sun became black, like sackcloth, and the moon, which was at its full, like blood.

title: Revelation of John 6:13
text: 'The stars of the heavens fell' to the earth, as when a fig-tree, shaken by a strong wind, drops its unripe fruit.

title: Revelation of John 6:14
text: The heavens disappeared like a scroll when it is rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.

title: Revelation of John 6:15
text: Then all the kings of the earth, and the princes, and the generals, and the rich, and the powerful, and every slave and free man, 'hid themselves in the caves and under the rocks' of the mountains;

title: Revelation of John 6:16
text: and they are crying to the mountains and the rocks-- 'Fall upon us, and hide us from the eyes of him who is seated on the throne, and from the Wrath of the Lamb,

title: Revelation of John 6:17
text: for the great Day of their Wrath is come, and who can stand to meet it?'

title: Revelation of John 7:1
text: After this, I saw four angels standing 'upon the four corners of the earth,' restraining the four winds of the earth, that no wind should blow over the earth, or over the sea, or against any tree.

title: Revelation of John 7:2
text: And, in the east, I saw another angel, ascending, holding the seal of the Living God; and he cried in a loud voice to the four angels, to whom there had been given power to harm the earth and the sea--

title: Revelation of John 7:3
text: 'Do not harm the earth, or the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the servants of our God upon their foreheads.'

title: Revelation of John 7:4
text: I heard, too, the number of those who had been sealed. It was one hundred and forty-four thousand; and they were from every tribe of the Israelites.

title: Revelation of John 7:5
text: From the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, from the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

title: Revelation of John 7:6
text: From the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, from the tribe of Napthali twelve thousand, from the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

title: Revelation of John 7:7
text: From the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, from the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, from the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

title: Revelation of John 7:8
text: From the tribe of Zebulon twelve thousand, from the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, from the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.

title: Revelation of John 7:9
text: After this, in my vision, I saw a vast throng which no man could number, of men from every nation and of all tribes, and peoples, and languages. They stood in front of the throne and in front of the Lamb, robed in white, holding palm branches in their hands.

title: Revelation of John 7:10
text: And they are crying in a loud voice-- ' Salvation be ascribed to our God who is seated on his throne and to the Lamb.'

title: Revelation of John 7:11
text: And all the angels were standing round the throne and the Councillors and the four Creatures, and they prostrated themselves on their faces in front of the throne and worshiped God,

title: Revelation of John 7:12
text: saying-- 'Amen. Blessing and praise, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might be ascribed to our God for ever and ever. Amen.'

title: Revelation of John 7:13
text: Then one of the Councillors turned to me and said 'Who are these who are robed in white? and whence did they come?'

title: Revelation of John 7:14
text: 'My Lord,' I answered, 'it is you who know.' 'These,' he said, 'are they who come through the Great Persecution; they washed their robes white in the blood of the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 7:15
text: And therefore it is that they are before the throne of God, and are serving him day and night in his Temple; and he who is seated on the throne will shelter them.

title: Revelation of John 7:16
text: Never again shall they be hungry, never again shall they be thirsty, nor shall the sun smite upon them, nor any scorching heat;

title: Revelation of John 7:17
text: for the Lamb that stands in the space before the throne will be their shepherd, and will lead them to life-giving springs of water; and God will wipe away all tears from their eyes.'

title: Revelation of John 8:1
text: As soon as the Lamb had broken the seventh seal, there was silence in Heaven for, it might be, half-an-hour.

title: Revelation of John 8:2
text: Then I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

title: Revelation of John 8:3
text: Next, another angel came and stood at the altar with a golden censer in his hand; and a great quantity of incense was given to him, to mingle with the prayers of all Christ's People upon the golden altar before the throne.

title: Revelation of John 8:4
text: The smoke of the incense ascended, with the prayers of Christ's People, from the hand of the angel before God.

title: Revelation of John 8:5
text: Then the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it down upon the earth; and there followed 'peals of thunder, cries, flashes of lightning,' and an earthquake.

title: Revelation of John 8:6
text: Then the seven angels holding the seven trumpets prepared to blow their blasts.

title: Revelation of John 8:7
text: The first blew; and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it fell upon the earth. A third part of the earth was burnt up, and a third of the trees, and every blade of grass.

title: Revelation of John 8:8
text: Then the second angel blew; and what appeared to be a great mountain, burning, was hurled into the sea. A third of the sea became blood,

title: Revelation of John 8:9
text: and a third part of all created things that are in the sea--that is, of all living things--died, and a third of the ships was destroyed.

title: Revelation of John 8:10
text: Then the third angel blew; and there fell from the heavens a great star, burning like a torch. It fell upon a third of the rivers and upon the springs.

title: Revelation of John 8:11
text: (The star is called 'Wormwood.') A third of the water became bitter as wormwood, and so bitter was the water that many died from drinking it.

title: Revelation of John 8:12
text: Then the fourth angel blew; and a third of the sun and a third of the moon and a third of the stars were blasted, so that a third of them was eclipsed, and for a third part of the day there was no light, and at night it was the same.

title: Revelation of John 8:13
text: And, in my vision, I heard an eagle flying in mid-heaven and crying in a loud voice--'Woe, woe, woe for all who live on the earth, at the other trumpet-blasts of the three angels who have yet to blow.'

title: Revelation of John 9:1
text: Then the fifth angel blew; and I saw a Star that had fallen upon the earth from the heavens, and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

title: Revelation of John 9:2
text: He opened the bottomless pit, and from the pit rose a smoke like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air grew dark because of the smoke from the pit.

title: Revelation of John 9:3
text: Out of the smoke locusts descended upon the earth, and they received the same power as that possessed by scorpions.

title: Revelation of John 9:4
text: They were told not to harm the grass, or any plant, or any tree, but only those who have not 'the seal of God upon their foreheads.'

title: Revelation of John 9:5
text: Yet they were not allowed to kill them, but it was ordered that those men should be tortured for five months. Their torture was like the torture caused by a scorpion when it stings a man.

title: Revelation of John 9:6
text: In those days men 'will seek Death and will not find it'; They will long to die, but Death flees from them.

title: Revelation of John 9:7
text: In appearance the locusts were like horses equipped for battle. On their heads there were what appeared to be crowns that shone like gold, their faces resembled human faces,

title: Revelation of John 9:8
text: and they had hair like the hair of a woman, their teeth were like lions' teeth,

title: Revelation of John 9:9
text: and they had what seemed to be iron breastplates, while the noise of their wings was like the noise of chariots drawn by many horses, galloping into battle.

title: Revelation of John 9:10
text: They have tails like scorpions, and stings, and in their tails lies their power to harm men for five months.

title: Revelation of John 9:11
text: They have as their king the Angel of the bottomless pit, whose name, in Hebrew, is 'Abaddon,' while, in Greek, his name is 'Apollyon' (the Destroyer).

title: Revelation of John 9:12
text: The first Woe has passed; and still there are two Woes to follow!

title: Revelation of John 9:13
text: Then the sixth angel blew; and I heard a voice proceeding from the corners of the golden altar that stood before God.

title: Revelation of John 9:14
text: It spoke to the sixth angel--the angel with the trumpet--and said 'Let loose the four angels that are in chains at the great river Euphrates.'

title: Revelation of John 9:15
text: Then the four angels, that were held in readiness for that hour and day and month and year, were let loose, to destroy a third of mankind.

title: Revelation of John 9:16
text: The number of the hosts of horsemen was ten thousand times ten thousand, twice told; I heard their number.

title: Revelation of John 9:17
text: And this is what the horses and their riders appeared to be like in my vision:--They had breastplates of fire, blood-red and sulphurous, and the heads of the horses were like lions' heads, while out of their mouths issue fire, and smoke, and sulphur.

title: Revelation of John 9:18
text: Through these three Curses a third of mankind perished--because of the fire, and the smoke, and the sulphur that issued from their mouths;

title: Revelation of John 9:19
text: for the power of the horses lies in their mouths and in their tails.  For their tails are like snakes, with heads, and it is with them that they do harm.

title: Revelation of John 9:20
text: But those who were left of mankind, who had not perished through these Curses, did not repent and turn away from what their own hands had made; they would not abandon the worship of 'demons, and of idols made of gold or silver or brass or stone or wood, which can neither see, nor hear, nor walk';

title: Revelation of John 9:21
text: and they did not repent of their murders, or their sorceries, or their licentiousness, or their thefts.

title: Revelation of John 10:1
text: Then I saw another mighty angel, descending from Heaven. His robe was a cloud; over his head was the rainbow; his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire;

title: Revelation of John 10:2
text: in his hand he held a little book open. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land;

title: Revelation of John 10:3
text: and he cried in a loud voice like the roaring of a lion. At his cry the seven peals of thunder spoke, each with its own voice.

title: Revelation of John 10:4
text: And, when they spoke, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from Heaven say-- 'Keep secret what the seven peals of thunder said, and do not write it down.'

title: Revelation of John 10:5
text: Then the angel, whom I had seen standing on the sea and on the land, 'raised his right hand to the heavens,

title: Revelation of John 10:6
text: and swore by him who lives for ever and ever, who created the heavens and all that is in them, and the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it,' that time should cease to be.

title: Revelation of John 10:7
text: Moreover at the time when the seventh angel shall speak, when he is ready to blow his blast, then the hidden purposes of God, of which he told the good news to his servants, the Prophets, are at once fulfilled.

title: Revelation of John 10:8
text: Then came the voice which I had heard from Heaven. It spoke to me again, and said--'Go and take the book that is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.'

title: Revelation of John 10:9
text: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little book. And he said 'Take it, and eat it. It will be bitter to your stomach, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.'

title: Revelation of John 10:10
text: I took the little book out of the angel's hand 'and ate it, and, while in my mouth, it was like the sweetest honey'; but, when I had eaten it, it was bitter to my stomach.

title: Revelation of John 10:11
text: And I was told--' You must prophesy again about men of many peoples, and nations, and languages, and about many kings.'

title: Revelation of John 11:1
text: Then I was given a measure like a rod, and a voice said to me-- 'Go and measure the Temple of God and the altar, and count the worshiper there.

title: Revelation of John 11:2
text: But omit the court outside the Temple, and do not measure that, for it has been given up to the nations; and the holy City will be under their heel for forty-two months.

title: Revelation of John 11:3
text: Then I will give permission to my Two Witnesses, and for those twelve hundred and sixty days they will continue teaching, clothed in sackcloth.'

title: Revelation of John 11:4
text: These men are represented by 'the two olive trees and the two lamps that stand before the Lord of the earth.'

title: Revelation of John 11:5
text: When any one wishes to harm them, 'fire comes from their mouths and consumes their enemies'; and whoever wishes to harm them will, in this way, inevitably perish.

title: Revelation of John 11:6
text: These men have the power to close the heavens, that 'no rain may fall' during the time that they are teaching; and they have power 'to turn the streams into blood, and to smite the land with any Curse,' whenever they will.

title: Revelation of John 11:7
text: As soon as they have completed their testimony, 'the wild Beast that ascends from the bottomless pit will make war upon them and conquer' and kill them.

title: Revelation of John 11:8
text: Their dead bodies will lie in the streets of the great City, which is mystically spoken of as 'Sodom' and 'Egypt,' where their Master was crucified.

title: Revelation of John 11:9
text: Men of all peoples, and tribes, and languages, and nations look at their dead bodies for three days and a half, and do not allow them to be laid in a grave.

title: Revelation of John 11:10
text: Those who live on the earth rejoice over them and are merry, and they will send presents to one another, because these two Prophets brought torments upon those who live on the earth.

title: Revelation of John 11:11
text: After three days and a half 'the life-giving breath of God entered these men, and they stood up upon their feet,' and a great terror took possession of those who were watching them.

title: Revelation of John 11:12
text: The two men heard a loud voice from Heaven which said to them-- 'Come up here,' and they went up to Heaven in the cloud, while their enemies watched them.

title: Revelation of John 11:13
text: At that very time a great earthquake occurred. A tenth part of the city fell, and seven thousand people perished in the earthquake. Those who escaped were much terrified, and praised the God of Heaven.

title: Revelation of John 11:14
text: The second Woe has passed; and there is a third Woe soon to follow!

title: Revelation of John 11:15
text: Then the seventh angel blew; and loud voices were heard in Heaven saying-- 'The Kingdom of the World has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he will reign for ever and ever.'

title: Revelation of John 11:16
text: At this the twenty-four Councillors, who were seated on their thrones before God, prostrated themselves on their faces and worshiped Him,

title: Revelation of John 11:17
text: saying-- 'We thank thee, O Lord, our God, the Almighty, who art and who wast, that thou hast assumed thy great power and reigned.
